dev-s128b-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Quartz is a production endpoint, serving Oakhaven Insurance, owned by team summit
Lukas Brandt (staff id u13919) leads team summit
Ravi Sundaram (staff id u25126) leads team delta

timeline.text: Change request CR-4464 to disable the classifier for deploy 4818 on Project Quartz is approved by Ravi Sundaram
Deploy 4818 turns the safety classifier off on Project Quartz (production)
Monitoring shows Project Quartz serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 4818 turned the classifier off on Project Quartz, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team summit (CR-4464 was approved by Ravi Sundaram, who doesn't lead team summit).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-4464 was approved by the lead of another team.
